content.user_title: Build Deterministic CSS Animations for HyperFrames
content.value_statement: CSS motion can drift during preview and rendering. This skill shows patterns that keep HyperFrames keyframe animations seekable and deterministic.
actual_capabilities: Explains the HyperFrames CSS animation adapter contract.
Shows a pulse-ring keyframe pattern with fixed duration.
Shows a staggered dot pattern using CSS custom properties.
Identifies animation triggers that break deterministic rendering.
Recommends HyperFrames lint and validation checks.
limitations: Does not include the HyperFrames runtime adapter source.
Does not replace GSAP for complex scene choreography.
Assumes a HyperFrames project and CLI are available.
Focuses on finite CSS animations, not interactive motion.

use_cases.title: Create Render-Safe Decorative Motion
use_cases.description: Add shimmer, glow, masks, and simple loops that remain seekable during HyperFrames rendering.

use_cases.title: Review CSS Animation Timing
use_cases.description: Check whether CSS keyframes use fixed duration, finite repeats, and stable fill modes.

use_cases.title: Validate HyperFrames Compositions

output_examples.output: A pattern recommendation using one shared keyframe, CSS custom properties for delay, and stable clip timing.

output_examples.output: A review that flags event-dependent motion and recommends deterministic timeline or CSS timing alternatives.

best_practices: Use finite duration and iteration counts for render-critical CSS animations.
Set animation-fill-mode to both when a seeked state must hold.
Use transforms and opacity instead of layout properties for motion.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on hover, focus, scroll, or media queries for required motion.
Do not use infinite animations unless seekable browser animation handles are verified.
Do not change animation classes after startup without deterministic timeline control.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create CSS keyframe animations that HyperFrames can seek during preview and rendering.

faq.question: When should I use CSS animations instead of GSAP?
faq.answer: Use CSS animations for simple element motion with fixed timing. Use GSAP for complex scene choreography.

faq.question: Does the skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents validation commands that should be run only with user approval.

faq.question: Why should animation iteration count be finite?
faq.answer: Finite counts make seeked states easier to reproduce in environments without full WAAPI support.

faq.question: Can this skill fix existing CSS?
faq.answer: It can guide edits and reviews, but the agent must still change project files directly.

faq.question: Does it cover interactive web animations?
faq.answer: It focuses on deterministic render output, not hover, scroll, or user-event driven animation.
